name: Arcturus Defense Solutions ARC-P1 'Centurion'
description:
The Arcturus Defense Solutions ARC-P1 is a full-size combat pistol chambered in .45 ACP, built on a steel frame with an integrated accessory rail and oversized trigger guard for gloved operation. The weapon is over-engineered by civilian standards — the slide rails are hand-fitted, the barrel bushing is match-grade, and the frame is coated in Arcturus's proprietary CeraShield finish that resists corrosion, abrasion, and chemical exposure.

The Centurion is Arcturus's entry into the conventional firearms market, and it reflects the company's military contracting DNA. Every component is built to survive conditions that most civilian pistols will never encounter. The result is a heavy, accurate, exceptionally reliable pistol that costs four times what a comparable weapon from any other manufacturer would cost.

Arcturus doesn't compete on price. The Centurion exists as a halo product — proof that the same company building electromagnetic accelerator rifles and directed-energy platforms can also make a conventional pistol better than anyone else. Whether that premium is justified is debatable, but the people who buy Centurions don't care about the debate.
specifications:
caliber: .45 ACP
effective_range: 50 meters
rate_of_fire: Semi-automatic
magazine_capacity: 10 rounds
weight: 1.15 kg
tactical_use: A premium combat pistol offering exceptional accuracy and reliability in adverse conditions. The .45 ACP round provides solid terminal performance against unarmored and lightly armored targets. The weight helps manage recoil for follow-up shots. Suitable for deliberate aimed fire in defensive and offensive operations. The integrated rail supports lights, lasers, and compact optics.
cultural_context: The Centurion is a statement piece for people who want everyone to know they can afford the best conventional sidearm available. In firearms culture, it occupies a position similar to a luxury watch — technically unnecessary given cheaper alternatives, but carrying one says something specific about the owner's resources and priorities.
known_users: Arcturus Defense Solutions executive protection teams
story_hooks: An Arcturus executive is murdered with his own Centurion — and the CeraShield coating has been chemically stripped in a way that shouldn't be possible outside an Arcturus facility.
A batch of counterfeit Centurions is circulating that are externally perfect copies but built with substandard internals. Someone has access to Arcturus manufacturing data.

physical_description.visual_profile: A full-size combat pistol with aggressive, purposeful geometry. The slide is prominently beveled and serrated; the frame sits low and wide with a pronounced dust cover extending forward. The oversized trigger guard creates a distinctive squared-off silhouette. It reads as serious, purpose-built hardware — no aesthetic compromises.
physical_description.dimensions: Length: 21.6 cm | Height: 13.7 cm (including sights) | Width: 3.3 cm | Barrel length: 12.7 cm
physical_description.weight_description: Substantial and reassuring in hand — 1.15 kg gives it genuine heft without feeling unwieldy. The steel frame provides ballast that settles the weapon during recoil management.
physical_description.primary_material: Forged steel frame and slide with hand-fitted precision tolerances. Match-grade steel barrel with polished feed ramp.
physical_description.finish: CeraShield proprietary ceramic-polymer coating in gunmetal gray with a matte, slightly textured surface resistant to gloss and reflection.
physical_description.color_scheme: Gunmetal gray primary with dark charcoal accents on the slide serrations. Stainless steel trigger and small internal components visible through the oversized trigger guard.
physical_description.grip_texture: Aggressive grip texture — aggressive 25 LPI checkering in a diagonal pattern covering the front and back strap. Feels like fine sandpaper under gloved fingers.
distinctive_features: Aggressive front and rear slide serrations with sharp, pronounced edges
Oversized trigger guard (can accommodate two fingers or heavy tactical gloves)
Integrated Picatinny rail under the dust cover, precisely machined flush
Beveled magazine well for rapid reloads
Night sight dovetails (white outline rear, white-dot front)
Match-grade barrel crown visible in the muzzle
Heavily stippled grip panels with ergonomic undercut behind the trigger guard
Recessed slide stop and magazine release — no sharp snags
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: ARCTURUS DEFENSE SOLUTIONS etched in block capitals along the left slide. ARC-P1 CENTURION stamped below. Serial plate mounted on the frame beneath the slide, engraved. CeraShield™ trademark marked discreetly on the left frame near the trigger guard.
physical_description.condition_typical: Factory fresh or well-maintained field condition. Even heavily used examples show minimal cosmetic wear due to CeraShield durability — finish remains matte and unmarred. Internally immaculate with tight tolerances preserved through component quality.
